summary: Frontend regression for unified NavTabs + Dashboard LatencyTrendChart. All 14 requested checks pass: admin login lands on /, primary nav renders 7 tabs with correct data-testids, wrapped in data-testid=nav-primary (role=tablist), each click navigates to correct route and sets aria-current=page. TOOLS/LEARN/ADMIN dropdowns open with all expected menu items, close on Escape and on outside click; admin dropdown gated on role=admin (visible for admin user). Dashboard: latency-trend-chart present, latency-trend-svg rendered (8 real runs), hovering the chart reveals latency-trend-tooltip; all 5 KPI cells present; 16 category-* cards render. Training Inbox: training-inbox-filter-tabs plus filter-pending/promoted/dismissed/all all present; clicking filter-promoted sets aria-current=page. OutputView: output-view-tabs plus TEXT/HEX/B64/DIFF present; TEXT default active; DIFF aria-disabled=true when HEX active, aria-disabled unset when TEXT active; clicking DIFF while TEXT active activates diff (aria-current=page). Backend smoke via authenticated curl: GET /api/rc5/golden/history?limit=20 -> 200, 8 entries with fields ts/p50_ms/p95_ms/mitre_technique_count (plus run_id/total/passed/failed/pass_rate/regression_count/mean_ms); GET /api/rc5/golden/summary -> 200 with has_data=true, total=88. No console errors observed on any route (only expected 403s were from an unauthenticated in-page fetch during smoke, which is correct auth enforcement).
critical_code_review_comments: NavTabs uses inline styles heavily — acceptable for a design-token island, but a future refactor could move TONES/SIZES into CSS custom properties for easier theming.
NavDropdown 'anyActive' logic uses startsWith(item.to + '/'), matching NavTabs — consistent and correct.
OutputView correctly encodes state semantics: activeKey resolves to 'diff' only when view==='text' && showDiff, and DIFF is disabled outside TEXT view via aria-disabled — matches spec.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing 8 golden runs already in Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: NavTabs consolidation is fully wired and stable. Router-mode tabs sit on data-testid=nav-primary; state-mode tabs are used at training-inbox-filter-tabs and output-view-tabs. LatencyTrendChart renders when history is non-empty (currently 8 runs); empty state has data-testid=latency-trend-empty. /api/rc5/golden/history and /api/rc5/golden/summary require Bearer JWT auth (403 without).
